data.title: Track your money in and out
data.body: Record this month's income and expenses so your runway and burn are based on real numbers.

data.title: Get your key agreements signed
data.body: Send your founders' agreement or first customer contract for e-signature and get it fully signed.

data.title: Close out your next roadmap tasks
data.body: Finish the open tasks on your nearest milestone. Shipped work is the clearest product signal.

data.title: Complete your daily missions
data.body: Finish today's mission. Consistent execution on the highest-leverage tasks compounds fast.

data.title: Test your riskiest assumption
data.body: Pick the assumption that would sink you if wrong and run a quick experiment to validate or kill it.

data.title: Talk to customers this month
data.body: Log a few customer interviews. Real conversations beat assumptions every time.

data.title: Complete incorporation
data.body: Register the company and issue founder shares. Operating unincorporated exposes founders personally and blocks fundraising.

data.title: Sign a founders' agreement
data.body: Put equity splits, vesting, and roles in writing before it is contentious. This prevents the most common founder disputes.

data.title: Define your MVP scope
data.body: Write a one-page MVP definition: the single problem, the smallest feature set that solves it, and what you are deliberately leaving out.

data.title: Set up a user feedback loop
data.body: Put a lightweight channel in front of real users (calls, a form, a Slack) and commit to reviewing it weekly.

data.title: Write a one-page ICP
data.body: Define your ideal customer profile: who they are, the pain, and why now. Specificity beats reach at this stage.

data.title: Build a 12-month runway model
data.body: Model monthly cash in/out for 12 months so you know your runway and the month you must raise or break even.

data.title: Map your top 5 competitors
data.body: List the five closest alternatives (including 'do nothing') and one sentence on how you differ from each.

data.title: Clarify founder roles & equity
data.body: Write down who owns what decisions and the equity split with vesting. Ambiguity here compounds fast.

data.title: Run a pricing experiment
data.body: Test one concrete price point with real prospects. Willingness-to-pay evidence de-risks your whole model.
